fields.explanation_id: stable lowercase snake_case identifier without year/version
fields.skill_ids: array of stable Skill Graph skill_id values
fields.subskill_ids: array of stable Skill Graph subskill_id values
fields.exam_task_numbers: derived current task-number links; not the identity of the skill
fields.rule: compact learner-facing explanation sufficient for the EGE use case
fields.common_traps: array of common misconceptions or false cues
fields.examples: original Eksamio examples, not copied trainer-bank exercises
fields.contrast_examples: optional pairs/groups for commonly confused cases
fields.verification_question: optional short comprehension check; not a replacement for next independent trainer item
fields.item_specific_notes: optional mapping for cases requiring card-specific explanation supplements

fields.source_path: repository-relative path or stable source identifier
fields.purpose: rule | exception | example_method | exam_format | criterion | terminology
